source.method: Instances of each variant (Size × Overflow, Value 8 and Overflow text 99+) in temporary frames with explicit Brand, Appearance and Density modes; bound variables resolved with resolveForConsumer; geometry read from the laid-out instance; frames removed. Records inside a Button are measured on the adapter variable button/foreground (proxy) until the orchestrator integrates the master into the Button.

records.note: The container has no color of its own in Figma: counter/foreground (alias of color/content/primary), bound to the Value fill and the Border stroke, stands for the inherited content color; the Button overrides it with button/foreground.

Code draws the border as an inset box-shadow in the content color at borderOpacity; Figma as an inside stroke on the Border layer (stroke bound to counter/foreground, width to border/width/default, layer opacity to the adapter variable counter/border-opacity = 70, because Figma reads an opacity binding in percent and opacity/muted holds 0.7). Observed: the effective layer opacity.
minWidth bound to typography/indicator/{size}/lineHeight (the line box); Chromium resolves 1lh in 1/64 px layout units (15.3906 for 15.4), tolerance 0.05px.

Height bound to typography/indicator/{size}/lineHeight: Figma rounds a text layer’s auto height to whole pixels, so the container cannot hug the text; Chromium lays the line box out in 1/64 px units, tolerance 0.05px. The Border layer matches the container size.

Justified: the Plugin API cannot set OpenType features (openTypeFeatures is read-only) and Inter’s default figures in Figma are proportional (widths at md: 11 → 12px, 88 → 16px). The measured values (8, 99+) contain no narrow digit; tabular figures must be switched on by hand (Type settings → Numbers → Tabular) on the typography/indicator text styles or on the Value layers.
